description: Essieux routiers du remembrement de Willebringen is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. Axes of roads of the Willebingen land consolidation (state of land consolidation), drawn up in 1997. The code for the administrative roads as described in the data definition was not included. In addition, it was recorded to which walking, cycling or car route the roads belong. Coverage: Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. The portal shows the English title as "Road axles of Willebringen land consolidation" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Vlaamse Landmaatschappij. Its keywords include SORESMA, NETWERK, FIETS, WEGSEGMENTEN, WILLEBRINGEN, AUTOROUTE. The listing shows 1998-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
